title: Injective Numbering of Head Descriptors
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet. A head descriptor consists of an optional machine state together with one of three output-status values; assigning to each descriptor its number in a fixed enumeration of all such descriptors is injective.
